E-Ledger – Functional Specification (v1)

This document defines all core platform functions, starting from Authentication, and explains how Country, Sector, and Supply-Chain Stakeholders dynamically shape the system behavior.


---

1. AUTHENTICATION & ONBOARDING (FOUNDATION LAYER)

1.1 User / Organization Sign-Up

Function: Create a verified digital identity on E-Ledger.

Inputs:

Email / Mobile

Password / SSO

Organization Name

Organization Type (Company / Individual / Authority)


Outputs:

Unique Organization ID

Primary Admin User



---

1.2 Country Selection (MANDATORY)

Function: Load country-specific rules, stakeholders, and compliance logic.

User Action: Select operating country

Example Countries:

India

USA

Nigeria

South Korea


System Impact:

Loads regulatory framework

Loads allowed sectors

Loads country-specific supply-chain roles

Locks compliance logic (GST / FDA / Customs etc.)


> Country selection is immutable once transactions start.




---

2. SECTOR SELECTION (DOMAIN RULE ENGINE)

2.1 Sector Selection Screen

Function: Activate sector-specific schemas and event types.

Available Sectors:

FMCG

Pharma

Excise (Alcohol / Tobacco)

Agriculture


System Impact:

Enables sector-specific data fields

Enables sector-specific compliance rules

Enables sector-specific stakeholders



---

3. STAKEHOLDER SELECTION (COUNTRY-AWARE)

3.1 Dynamic Stakeholder Loader

Function: Display valid supply-chain roles based on Country + Sector.


---

3.2 Stakeholder Examples (Auto-Loaded)

India

FMCG: Manufacturer → C&F Agent → Distributor → Retailer

Pharma: Manufacturer → CFA → Distributor → Chemist

Excise: Manufacturer → Depot → Wholesaler → Retail Vendor

Agriculture: Farmer → Aggregator → Processor → Exporter


USA

FMCG: Manufacturer → Distributor → Retail Chain

Pharma: Manufacturer → Wholesaler → Pharmacy / Hospital

Agriculture: Farm → Processor → Importer → Retail

Excise: Producer → Distributor → Retailer


Nigeria

FMCG: Importer → Distributor → Open Market Seller

Pharma: Importer → Distributor → Chemist

Agriculture: Farmer → Trader → Exporter


South Korea

FMCG: Manufacturer → Distributor → Retail

Pharma: Manufacturer → Hospital / Pharmacy

Agriculture: Cooperative → Exporter



---

3.3 Stakeholder Registration

Function: Bind organization to a supply-chain role.

Validation:

Business registration number

License number (sector-specific)

Tax / regulatory ID



---

4. ROLE-BASED ACCESS CONTROL (RBAC)

4.1 Role Assignment

Function: Assign permissions based on stakeholder role.

Examples:

Manufacturer: Create batch, issue invoice

Distributor: Acknowledge receipt

Retailer: Confirm sale

Regulator: Read-only access


> Permissions are derived from the Role Permission Matrix.




---

5. ERP INTEGRATION SETUP

5.1 ERP Selection

Function: Select ERP system used by the organization.

Options:

SAP / Oracle / Dynamics

Marg ERP

Tally

Zoho / Odoo

No ERP (Manual UI)



---

5.2 ERP Adapter Configuration

Function: Configure how events are captured from ERP.

Modes:

API integration

Webhook

File watcher / local agent

Manual entry



---

6. EVENT CREATION (CORE LEDGER FUNCTION)

6.1 Event Types (Sector-Agnostic)

Batch Created

Invoice Issued

Goods Dispatched

Goods Received

Returned

Recalled

Exported

Tax / Duty Triggered



---

6.2 Event Structure

Each event contains:

Event ID

Actor (Organization + Role)

Counterparty

ERP Reference Hash

Timestamp

Location

Sector & Country


> Events are immutable once committed.




---

7. COUNTERPARTY ACKNOWLEDGEMENT

7.1 Receipt Confirmation

Function: Downstream party acknowledges upstream event.

Example:

Distributor confirms receipt of manufacturer dispatch


Impact:

Closes transaction loop

Enables settlement / compliance



---

8. TRACEABILITY & VISIBILITY

8.1 Batch / Lot Trace

Function: End-to-end visibility across stakeholders.

Access:

Own data → full

Counterparty data → limited

Regulator → full read-only



---

9. COMPLIANCE & REGULATORY FUNCTIONS

9.1 Country-Specific Compliance Engine

Country	Compliance Logic

India	GST, E-way Bill, Excise
USA	FDA / FSMA 204
Nigeria	Customs, Anti-counterfeit
Korea	Export & audit



---

10. REGULATOR & AUDITOR ACCESS

10.1 Read-Only Nodes

Function: Allow regulators to verify events without modification rights.

No edit

No delete

Cryptographic verification only



---

11. ALERTS & EXCEPTIONS

11.1 Automated Alerts

Missing acknowledgement

Duplicate invoice

Suspicious return

Recall trigger



---

12. GOVERNANCE & ADMINISTRATION

12.1 Platform Governance

Role approval

Rule updates (country / sector)

Consortium management (where applicable)



---

13. AUDIT & FORENSICS

13.1 Audit Trail

Function: Provide legally verifiable history.

Time-stamped

Hash-linked

Cross-party verified



---

CORE DESIGN PRINCIPLE (SUMMARY)

> Country defines rules. Sector defines schema. Role defines permissions. ERP provides data. E-Ledger provides trust.

I’ve started writing all the functions end-to-end and placed them in a structured canvas document so you can review, edit, and iterate easily.
